Info

Inbound dependencies bundle for default safe trajectory router infrastructure factory.

class scaralang.infrastructure.trajectory.avoidance.router.dependencies.DefaultRouterDependencies(bounds: ScaraBounds, safety_margin_mm: float = 5.0, angular_step_rad: float = 0.2617993877991494)[source]¶

Bases: object

Inbound parameters for default trajectory router composition factory.

It defines:

attributes:
bounds - Manipulator workspace kinematic bounds configuration.
safety_margin_mm - Radial dead zone clearance clearance margin in mm.
angular_step_rad - Tangent bypass arc discretization angle in radians.
